narrative_summary: The multi-week snap-back finally cleared the 23.6% fib (7,498) that had rejected price twice, with a 7,537 close pushing within ~0.5% of the 6/15 swing high (7,578) as Monte Carlo flipped up-first (60.6%) and VIX eased below 16. But the structural picture remains Late Bull / Topping: ERP is pinned at the 0.48% valuation ceiling, breadth (McClellan ~933, net new highs 2.38%) and wide credit (junk spread 1.34%) still refuse to confirm the rally, and the up-first edge fails every regime threshold. With price grinding into resistance near the swing high on a middling intraday close, trim bias into strength remains the justified posture over chasing the breakout.
